graderOnly: The migration guarantee the user wants dropped is AC-003 in the completed scope: migration guidance in docs/usage.md for admin-tool developers moving off the browser-built CSV download. Before the run there are no recovery frames and no outstanding obligations (the case states recovery is inactive). The correct transition pushes exactly one frame: From DOCUMENTING, Owner SCOPING, FailureType SCOPING, ResumeAt DOCUMENTING, RerunThrough NONE.

The documentation record has two open Documenter-owned discrepancies, DOC-001 (README layout omits src/export.ts and the export folder) and DOC-002 (README omits the test:integration command). They are unrelated to the migration change and must stay recorded and open.
The implementation has no defects and no agent-discovered failure exists; the change is user-requested.

notes: Built on export-project (not export-documenting) because the case needs a scope with a migration guarantee from the start; rewriting export-documenting's scope after its verification and review would break their content citations and the history. Layers 50-66 follow export-documenting's cycle almost verbatim (same context, implementation, tests, and record structure) with one addition: scope work item 3 and AC-003, migration guidance in docs/usage.md for admin-tool developers moving off the browser-built CSV download (Request mentions migration notes). Design gives AC-002 and AC-003 no architectural impact; verification (COMPLETE, FULL) and implementation review (COMPLETE, no findings) record both as pending/permitted dependencies on Documenter. 68-guide adds the export section and the migration section to docs/usage.md. 70-doc-record adds the IN_PROGRESS documentation record citing assessed identities, with DOC-001 and DOC-002 open README gaps (Documenter-owned). STATE stays DOCUMENTING with FORWARD from REVIEWING_IMPLEMENTATION, recovery and obligations inactive as the case states. Compromise: because the case says recovery is inactive, 'existing recovery frames survive' can only be checked as FrameCount 1 after the push; the discrepancy half is exercised by DOC-001/DOC-002.
